## PR Checklist

Please review and confirm that your PR satisfies the following criteria:

- [ ] **Builds successfully**: Running `cargo check --all` and `npm run build` completes with exit code 0.
- [ ] **Tests pass**: Running `cargo test --all` and `npm test` completes successfully.
- [ ] **Documentation updated**: Any affected features, safety behaviors, or scheduling rules are documented in `README.md` or `docs/`.
- [ ] **Screenshots/GIFs included**: If this PR introduces visual UI changes, screenshots or screen recordings are attached.
- [ ] **Changelog updated**: Added a summary of your changes under the `## Unreleased` section of `CHANGELOG.md` (if applicable).
- [ ] **Surgical changes**: The PR contains only changes related to the targeted issue or feature (no unrelated edits or formatting modifications).
